title: Redesigned results cards and streamlined challenge navigation
body:
RESULTS CARD & POST-GAME DISCOVERY
- Redesigned daily results cards with clearer mystery location reveals, visual question deduction history, and prominent stats.
- Post-game field notes now display directly within the result summary for seamless geographic exploration.
- Streamlined mode selector when challenging friends to real-time duels.
- Your daily question and guess limits are unchanged.
